description: Findings that do not come from adjudicating claims. Most were observed during ground truth capture (S2) on the pages in sources.yaml; some were observed in the raw answer files (data/raw/), as stated in each finding's observed_in. Each records what was observed on the stated date. They are observations about page structure, hosting, discoverability and link attribution, not claims about the content of Kemira's disclosures or about what Kemira measures. Findings with a page_gap feed the S7 page list alongside claim-derived gaps.

findings.summary: The sustainability key indicators page on kemira.com loads its figures from an embedded tool on tools.eurolandir.com. The indicators themselves are not in the kemira.com page's HTML, so a crawler restricted to kemira.com does not reach them.

evidence.detail: Main content of the captured page is 38 characters (a date and the page heading). The page embeds an iframe from //tools.eurolandir.com/tools/ia/?companycode=sf-kra&v=sustainability&lang=en-gb.

page_gap.gap: Reported indicators not present in the page's own HTML.

findings.summary: None of the 21 captured kemira.com pages carries Organization, Corporation or FAQPage schema. Every page has the same default set (WebPage, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, ListItem, SearchAction, ReadAction, EntryPoint, PropertyValueSpecification; ImageObject on 8 pages). The one captured page with an FAQ block (S19, investor FAQ) has no FAQPage markup.

evidence.detail: schema_types in data/ground_truth/<id>/meta.json for every captured HTML page.
FAQ detected by its 'Frequently asked questions' heading; schema_types does not include FAQPage.

findings.implication: Without Organization schema, a model has no machine-readable assertion of Kemira's legal name, listing, headquarters or segment structure, and must infer entity facts from prose or from third parties.
findings.scope_note: Covers the pages in sources.yaml only, not the whole site.

page_gap.gap: No Organization/Corporation entity markup on any captured page; no FAQPage markup on the captured FAQ page.

findings.summary: The reports and presentations index on kemira.com links no interim or half-year report PDF. Its only document links are the Q2 2026 'Equity story in brief' fact sheet (PDF) and a key financials spreadsheet (XLSX).

evidence.detail: Links in <main>: kemira-q2-2026-equity-story-in-brief.pdf, kemira-q2-2026-key-financials.xlsx, and a YouTube playlist. No other report links.

findings.scope_note: Based on the server-rendered HTML as captured. A report list loaded by client-side script after page load would not appear in this capture.

page_gap.gap: No link to the half-year or interim report documents.

findings.summary: The January–June 2026 Half-Year Financial Report is hosted on the Cision newswire (mb.cision.com), not on kemira.com. A crawler restricted to kemira.com does not reach it.

evidence.detail: Document URL is on mb.cision.com. Not linked from the captured reports index (S18; see SF03).

findings.scope_note: No kemira.com copy was found on the captured pages. The site outside sources.yaml was not searched, so a copy elsewhere on kemira.com is not ruled out.

page_gap.gap: No kemira.com-hosted half-year report linked from the reports index.

findings.summary: Every URL captured from ChatGPT answers in this run carries the query parameter utm_source=chatgpt.com: 37 tagged links across all 10 ChatGPT answer files (29 distinct URLs), of which 15 point to www.kemira.com. No URL captured from Perplexity or Gemini carries it.
findings.implication: Visits arriving through these links are identifiable in standard web analytics by the utm_source=chatgpt.com parameter.

evidence.detail: citations field of each file: 37 URLs, all tagged ?utm_source=chatgpt.com; 15 on www.kemira.com. Per question: K01 1, K03 2, K04 4, K05 1, K06 2, K07 3, O01 12, O02 6, O03 6. Counts are links per file after de-duplication within the file.

findings.scope_note: Pass 1 only. ChatGPT URLs are inline links in the copied answer body; the interface's citation markers did not resolve to URLs in the copied text (README limit 10).

findings.summary: The captured pages give different figures for the same climate targets. The sustainability page states the Scope 1 and 2 target as 'by 50%' in its target text and as -52% in its target column; the climate page states -52%; the 2025 annual report and the January-June 2026 half-year report state -51.23%. Scope 3 is stated as -33% on both web pages and -32.5% in both reports.
findings.implication: The pages a model reads give different figures for the same target, which is why assistants differ: in this run each assistant's climate-target figure matched one of these published versions (see the source_conflict verdicts).

evidence.detail: Target text 'Reduce GHG emissions from Scope 1 and 2 by 50% by the end of 2030'; target column -52%; Scope 3 33% / -33%.
Scope 1 and 2 -52% by end-2030 vs 2018; Scope 3 -33% by end-2033.
Annual report 2025 p.23: Scope 1 and 2 51.23% by end-2030; Scope 3 32.5% by end-2033.

findings.scope_note: An observation about what the captured pages contain, not about the accuracy of Kemira's reporting.

page_gap.gap: Climate targets stated with different figures within the page and against the climate page and reports.

findings.summary: The captured documents give different dates for the same targets. The 2025 annual report dates the TRIF 2.2 target to the end of 2025 and the Diversity & Inclusion top-10% target to the end of 2025; the January-June 2026 half-year report dates them to the end of 2026, as does the sustainability page for Diversity & Inclusion.
findings.implication: Different documents give different dates for the same target, which is why assistants differ: in this run different ChatGPT answers matched different versions (TRIF 2.2 by end-2026 in K06, end-2025 in K07).

evidence.detail: Annual report 2025 p.23: TRIF 2.2 by the end of 2025; p.56 and p.23: D&I top 10% by the end of 2025.
Half-year report Jan-Jun 2026 p.12: TRIF target 2.2 by the end of 2026; D&I top 10% by the end of 2026.
D&I top 10% by the end of 2026.

findings.scope_note: An observation about what the captured documents contain, not about the accuracy of Kemira's reporting. The later document may supersede the earlier; both remain published.
